assessment: This study provides useful descriptive findings regarding levels of adiponectin and its associations with genetic variants and age in very old and centenarian men and women. Due to some missing data, the evidence supporting the conclusions about cross-sectional determinants of circulating levels of adiponectin in centenarians is incomplete. The evidence for conclusions about relationships between adiponectin and survival is also incomplete because of some missing data and unadjusted survival analyses.
